They fail on legitimate refactors and assert nothing about behaviour; 43 behaviour-test nodes are trapped inside them. The per-file verdict table with node counts is this ticket's first comment; the file list and every move are stated below. Cites are on origin/main 083620b0; counts are re-measured below.

## Approach

## Scope
In scope: the 25 deleted files, the two new files, the renamed file, and the destinations named above. Out of scope: every file under `src/` and `scripts/`, the `Makefile`, `pyproject.toml`, and every test module not named above (the CI-parity, check-script and import-scan modules belong to S2, S3 and S4 of this epic).

## Testing
Two `pytest --collect-only -q` runs over the files the ACs name, before and after, recorded on this ticket with the per-file counts. Each destination module is also run in full (`pytest <dest> -q`). Then `make verify`, the pre-push gate (lint + typecheck + CI's test selection).
